title: Cayley, Dedekind, and Dirichlet: Classical Algebra and Arithmetic LaTeX Drafts
version: 2026-05-29 Cayley current per-volume rebuild plus Dedekind and Dirichlet shelf
description:
This record is a public-facing shelf for modern LaTeX working drafts of selected classical algebra, arithmetic, and number-theory manuscripts by Arthur Cayley, Richard Dedekind, and P. G. Lejeune Dirichlet. Top-level PDFs are organized by author and volume/work so readers can download individual files directly. Source TeX, build notes, audit outputs, and provenance material are collected in the artifact ZIP.

Status at a glance.

  • Cayley reader surface: [#########-] front matter plus Volumes I-XIII are present as current compiled readers, 7116 pages total. The known remaining Cayley gaps are Volume VIII pages 292-303, Volume IX pages 551-575, and Volume XI pages 451-500.
  • Dedekind and Dirichlet reader surface: [######----] Dedekind Bands I-III and one Dirichlet selected-works grouping remain present as working drafts.
  • Technical PDF/display checks: [##########] promoted Cayley PDFs compile and open as normal PDF readers; earlier public Cayley readers with literal TeX command leakage have been replaced.
  • Mathematical proofreading: [----------] working drafts for checking and correction, not certified critical editions.

Workflow. Public-domain scans and witnesses are converted into TeX drafts, checked into readable PDFs, and packaged with source artifacts for inspection and correction. The public organization is by author, work, or corpus; raw process material is kept in artifact ZIPs rather than in public titles or reader PDFs.
notes: Focused public-facing working-draft shelf for Cayley, Dedekind, and Dirichlet. Latest update promotes the current Cayley per-volume rebuild and preserves TeX/source artifacts in 80 Classical Algebra and Arithmetic - Sources, TeX, and Audits.zip.
